entries.title_en: Content-Based Search Tools for Large Sets of Print and Manuscript Music
entries.title_zh: 大型印刷與手稿樂譜館藏的內容式檢索工具：巴伐利亞國家圖書館用 SmartScore 與 MuRET 兩條 OMR 管線、加上 250 萬筆人工輸入的 RISM 樂曲開頭，全部收斂成只留音高與音程的 3–8 音 n-gram 索引（不看節奏、和弦只取最高音）——一篇經驗分享型的教學文章，沒有檢索效能或 OMR 錯誤率的任何數字
entries.why_zh: 巴伐利亞國家圖書館（BSB）兩位館員寫的教學文章，說明他們如何把 OMR 輸出與 RISM 樂曲開頭（incipit）接進圖書館的旋律檢索服務。今天是週一：arXiv 三個列表停在 11-20（週五）的公告，其中跟音樂有關的論文都讀過了，所以照週一規則掃 TISMIR。TISMIR 第一頁只剩兩篇未讀（音樂學教學的立場文章、AI 輔助創作的智慧財產哲學——後者跟昨天的著作權綜述主題太近），因此往第二頁找，依使用者在追的子領域優先挑了這篇 OMR。值得讀的地方是它談的是「規模」：16 萬頁 OMR 資料只占館藏樂譜印本的 0.6%，以及在這種規模下他們刻意丟掉哪些音樂資訊。它沒有任何量化評估，評估重點放在設計取捨是否站得住。
entries.why_en: A teaching article by two librarians at the Bavarian State Library (BSB) on how they feed OMR output and RISM incipits into the library's melodic search services. Today is Monday: the three arXiv lists stop at the 11-20 (Friday) announcements and every music-related paper in them has already been read, so per the Monday rule I scanned TISMIR. Page 1 of TISMIR has only two unread articles (a position paper on musicology pedagogy and an IP-philosophy essay on AI-assisted creativity, the latter too close to yesterday's copyright overview), so I went to page 2 and, giving priority to the subfields the user is tracking, picked this OMR article. It is worth reading because it is about scale: 160,000 pages of OMR data are only 0.6% of the library's printed music, and it explains which musical information they deliberately throw away at that scale. It has no quantitative evaluation, so the review focuses on whether the design trade-offs hold up.

motivation.zh:
作者的出發點是一個研究型圖書館的實際處境：OMR 研究在單一語料上常報告「好到很好」的結果，但一座館藏從中世紀記譜、共通西方記譜到非歐洲記譜都有的圖書館，沒有任何一套 OMR 能涵蓋全部。而且 OMR 只是第一步，後面還要把資料接進館藏目錄、做查詢介面、做比對與排序，最後還得有機構願意長期維護。

具體數字讓這個落差很清楚：BSB 約有 50 萬冊樂譜印本，數位化約 2 萬冊（4%），其中做過 OMR 的約 3,000 冊、約 16 萬頁，只占全部印本的 0.6%。2024–2026 年的新計畫要再加約 2,000 冊 16–17 世紀早期印本、約 35 萬頁，以及 133 本手抄合唱譜。這篇文章想回答的是：在這種規模與異質性下，什麼樣的 OMR 與索引設計是可行、可維護的。作者明說方法本身不新，文章定位是給實務者、研究者與學生的教學資源。
motivation.en:
The authors start from the practical situation of a research library. OMR research often reports good to very good results on a single corpus, but a library whose holdings span medieval notation, Common Western Music Notation and non-European notation has no single OMR system that covers everything. OMR is also only the first step: the data must then be integrated into catalogs, given a query interface and matched and ranked, and some institution has to be willing to maintain all of it.

The numbers make the gap concrete. BSB holds about 500,000 music prints; about 20,000 (4%) are digitized, and about 3,000 of those, roughly 160,000 pages, have been through OMR, which is only 0.6% of all prints. A 2024–2026 project adds about 2,000 early prints from the 16th and 17th centuries (about 350,000 pages) plus 133 handwritten choirbooks. The question the article addresses is which OMR and indexing designs are feasible and maintainable at this scale and heterogeneity. The authors state plainly that the methods are not new; the article is meant as a teaching resource for practitioners, researchers and students.

intro.zh:
文章本身的相關研究寫得很誠實：檢索核心是 Downie（1999）把旋律切成 n-gram 當文字處理的做法；Hankinson 等人（2012）在 SIMSSA 框架下首次把 OMR 管線接上 n-gram 檢索，但只用在《Liber Usualis》這種單一同質語料，而且存了五種特徵，BSB 只存其中兩種（音高與音程）。F-TEMPO（Crawford 等人，2023）做的是跨館早期印本的「整頁比對」，OmniOMR（Hajič jr. 等人，2023）則是捷克兩個機構把 OMR 檢索加進大型圖書館館藏，作者自己也說它是最接近的對照。

文章沒提、但最值得對照的是 Peachnote（Viro，2011）：它早在十幾年前就把 IMSLP 數十萬頁樂譜跑過 OMR，再用旋律 n-gram 建跨館藏的檢索與統計，規模與想法都跟 musiconn.scoresearch 非常接近。另外「每個譜表只保留最高音」其實就是 Uitdenbogerd 與 Zobel（1998）的 skyline 演算法，用來從複音音樂抽出旋律的經典捷徑，文中只把它描述成實作上的簡化。所以這篇的貢獻不在方法，而在把這些既有技巧放進一個真實、仍在運作的圖書館服務裡，並記錄整合時遇到的問題。
intro.en:
The article's own related-work section is honest. The retrieval core is Downie's (1999) approach of cutting melodies into n-grams and treating them as text. Hankinson et al. (2012), within SIMSSA, first connected an OMR pipeline to n-gram search, but only on a single homogeneous corpus (the Liber Usualis) and with five stored features, of which BSB stores only two (pitches and intervals). F-TEMPO (Crawford et al., 2023) does page-wise comparison of early prints across libraries, and OmniOMR (Hajič jr. et al., 2023), a collaboration of two Czech institutions adding OMR-based search to a large library's holdings, is described by the authors themselves as the closest point of comparison.

The most relevant comparison the article does not mention is Peachnote (Viro, 2011), which more than a decade ago ran OMR over hundreds of thousands of IMSLP pages and built cross-collection search and statistics on melodic n-grams, close to musiconn.scoresearch in both scale and idea. Likewise, keeping only the highest note per staff is essentially the skyline algorithm of Uitdenbogerd and Zobel (1998), the classic shortcut for extracting a melody from polyphonic music, which the article only describes as an implementation simplification. So the contribution is not the method but placing these existing techniques in a real, running library service and documenting the integration problems.

method.zh:
**一個索引，三條管線。** 所有資料最後都進 Apache Solr，以音高序列與音程序列兩種形式儲存；查詢切成 3 到 8 個音的重疊 n-gram 後比對。為了效率與穩健度刻意大幅簡化：每個譜表獨立處理、和弦只取最高音、索引與查詢都不考慮節奏。作者引用 Padilla 等人（2015）的觀察支持這個取捨：OMR 最常錯的正是節奏、漏掉的音與休止符，丟掉節奏等於繞過最不可靠的部分。

**第一條：SmartScore。** 2017 年起用商用軟體 SmartScore 批次處理 19 世紀全集印本（貝多芬、韓德爾、李斯特、孟德爾頌、舒伯特、舒曼全集等），平均每小時 70 張影像，輸出 MusicXML，原本只取每個譜表的第一聲部。

**第二條：MuRET。** SmartScore 處理不了定量記譜（mensural notation），所以 16–17 世紀語料改用阿利坎特大學的 MuRET（以 YOLO 偵測譜表，再用 CRNN＋CTC 辨識符號）。訓練用 21 份樣本、共 5,136 張影像，分兩階段：先辨識並人工校正前 20 張，再從每份剩下的影像均勻抽 10% 重跑並再校正一次；整個模型反覆訓練校正花了一年半以上。MuRET 輸出 MEI，所以整條管線改成 MEI，舊的 SmartScore 資料也用 Verovio 批次轉成 MEI 重建索引，順便讓多聲部可以分開索引。

**第三條：RISM。** 約 250 萬筆以 Plaine & Easie Code 人工輸入的單聲部樂曲開頭，本來就是單旋律，可以直接轉成音高序列；節奏有記錄但只用來顯示。查詢介面是兩個服務共用的：點選式鋼琴鍵盤、電腦鍵盤對應鋼琴黑白鍵（例如 D5=W、D♯5=3），或直接打 C5F5G5G#5，並有即時播放與五線譜顯示，可選完全比對或移調比對。
method.en:
**One index, three pipelines.** All data end up in Apache Solr, stored both as pitch sequences and as interval sequences; queries are cut into overlapping n-grams of 3 to 8 notes and matched. The simplification is deliberate, for efficiency and robustness: each staff is processed separately, only the highest note of a chord is kept, and neither indexing nor querying considers rhythm. The authors cite Padilla et al. (2015) in support: wrong rhythms and missing notes and rests are among the most frequent OMR errors, so dropping rhythm sidesteps the least reliable part.

**Pipeline one: SmartScore.** From 2017, the commercial SmartScore batch-processed 19th-century complete editions (Beethoven, Handel, Liszt, Mendelssohn, Schubert, Schumann and others) at an average of 70 images per hour, producing MusicXML, originally keeping only the first voice per staff.

**Pipeline two: MuRET.** SmartScore cannot handle mensural notation, so the 16th- and 17th-century corpus uses MuRET from the University of Alicante (YOLO for staff detection, then a CRNN with CTC for symbols). Training used 21 sample sources with 5,136 images in two phases: first the initial 20 images were recognized and manually corrected, then an evenly distributed 10% of each source's remaining images were processed and corrected again; the training-and-correction cycle took over 1.5 years. MuRET outputs MEI, so the whole pipeline moved to MEI and the old SmartScore data were batch-converted with Verovio and reindexed, which also lets multiple voices be indexed separately.

**Pipeline three: RISM.** About 2.5 million monophonic incipits entered by hand in Plaine & Easie Code can be turned directly into pitch sequences; rhythm is stored but used only for display. The query interface is shared by both services: a clickable piano keyboard, computer-keyboard rows mapped to piano keys (e.g. D5=W, D♯5=3), or typed text such as C5F5G5G#5, with live playback and notation display, and a choice of exact or transposed matching.

limitation.zh:
**沒有任何量化評估。** 全文沒有 OMR 的符號錯誤率、沒有檢索的準確率或召回率、沒有查詢延遲，也沒有「丟掉節奏與和弦內聲」讓錯誤匹配增加多少的估計。作者主張簡化「抹平了部分 OMR 錯誤」，但這是一個可以量的宣稱（例如在人工校正過的子集上比對 OMR 前後的檢索結果），文章沒有量。使用者回饋在致謝裡被明說是「非正式收集」，所以「有些使用者覺得有用」的兩個用例（追溯改編、辨認佚名作品）只是軼事。

**簡化的代價沒有被正面討論。** 只取最高音意味著內聲、低音聲部的主題在共通西方記譜的鍵盤與管弦樂譜中幾乎找不到；不看節奏則讓短的 3 音 n-gram 在 16 萬頁裡會有大量偶然命中。這些是設計上的取捨，但讀者拿不到任何數字判斷它划不划算。

**很多東西還沒公開。** MEI 解析器、VuFind 輸入元件都寫「完成後會釋出」；MuRET 模型與訓練印本則要向阿利坎特大學「申請」；大量 OMR 資料也是「依申請提供」。對一篇以教學與可重現為定位的文章，這讓其他機構暫時無法照做。
limitation.en:
**There is no quantitative evaluation.** The article reports no OMR symbol error rate, no retrieval precision or recall, no query latency, and no estimate of how many false matches dropping rhythm and inner voices adds. The authors claim the simplification smooths over some OMR errors, but that is a measurable claim (for example, comparing retrieval on a manually corrected subset before and after OMR) and it is not measured. User feedback is stated in the acknowledgments to have been gathered informally, so the two use cases some users find helpful (tracing adaptations, identifying anonymous works) are anecdotes.

**The cost of the simplification is not discussed head-on.** Keeping only the highest note means themes in inner or bass voices of CWMN keyboard and orchestral scores are nearly unfindable, and ignoring rhythm means short 3-note n-grams will produce many chance hits across 160,000 pages. These are design trade-offs, but the reader gets no numbers to judge whether they pay off.

**Much is not yet released.** The MEI parser and the VuFind input components are to be released once finished; the MuRET model and training prints are available on request from the University of Alicante; larger sets of OMR data are also on request. For an article positioned as educational and reproducible, this means other institutions cannot yet follow it.

discussion.zh:
這篇最有價值的不是技術，而是第 6 節講的「作品與版本」問題。用旋律查詢時，使用者心裡想的是抽象的「作品」，但館藏目錄描述的是特定版本與實體。例子很具體：查貝多芬「命運動機」g′–g′–g′–e♭′，貝多芬本人的命中顯示 1862–1865 年，因為它繼承的是 Breitkopf & Härtel 全集的書目紀錄；Samuel Scheidt（1587–1654）的《Tabulatura nova》則顯示 1892 年，是《德意志音樂文獻》那一冊的出版年。想用旋律檢索研究風格演變的人，會被這個日期落差直接誤導。

這點對 MIR 研究者是個提醒：OMR 論文的評估幾乎都停在符號層級，但真正決定一個檢索服務能不能用的，常常是 OMR 之外的詮釋資料。作者的建議方向（把 OMR、OCR 與版面辨識整合起來抽出作曲家與歌詞開頭，再接權威檔與 linked data）跟最近 OMR 界談的「全頁理解」一致，也是 RISM 已經靠幾十年人工編目做到的事。

整體而言，這是一份有用的實務紀錄：它清楚說明為什麼要用 MEI 當共同格式、為什麼要容許多套 OMR 並存，以及一個橫跨 Java／PHP／JavaScript 開發與音樂學的團隊花了多少時間。但若要當成其他機構的設計依據，還缺一組最基本的數字——簡化後的檢索到底找回了多少該找到的東西。
discussion.en:
The most valuable part is not the technology but the work-versus-edition problem in Section 6. A user searching by melody is thinking of an abstract work, but library catalogs describe a particular edition and physical item. The examples are concrete: searching Beethoven's fate motif g′–g′–g′–e♭′ returns Beethoven's own match dated 1862–1865, because it inherits the record of the Breitkopf & Härtel edition, and Samuel Scheidt's (1587–1654) Tabulatura nova appears as 1892, the publication year of the Denkmäler deutscher Tonkunst volume. Anyone using melodic search to study stylistic change would be misled by these date gaps.

This is a useful reminder for MIR researchers: OMR evaluation almost always stops at the symbol level, but what decides whether a search service is usable is often the metadata outside OMR. The authors' proposed direction (combining OMR, OCR and layout recognition to extract composers and text incipits, then linking to authority files and linked data) matches the recent OMR push toward full-page understanding, and it is what RISM already achieves through decades of manual cataloging.

Overall this is a useful practical record: it explains clearly why MEI serves as the common format, why several OMR systems must coexist, and how much time a cross-disciplinary team spanning Java, PHP, JavaScript and musicology needed. But as a design basis for other institutions it still lacks the most basic number: how much of what should be found the simplified search actually retrieves.

entries.title_en: MusiQAl: A Dataset for Music Question–Answering through Audio–Video Fusion
entries.title_zh: MusiQAl：以影音融合做音樂問答的資料集——310 段表演影片（5 小時以上、18 國、47 種樂器，含歌唱與舞蹈）、11,793 組音樂學背景標註者給的問答，在 MUSIC-AVQA 的 33 個模板外新增 47 個，加入「因果」與「目的」兩類問題；AVST 與 LAVISH 兩個 143 類封閉式分類基線的整體平均只有 68.21% 與 69.78%，但沒有只看問題的偏差基線，也沒報標註一致性
entries.authors: Anna-Maria Christodoulou, Kyrre Glette, Olivier Lartillot, Alexander Refsum Jensenius
entries.why_zh: 奧斯陸大學 RITMO 團隊的資料集論文，把音樂問答從「哪個樂器先響」這類場景描述，推向表演者動作、觀眾互動與「為什麼」的因果問題。同樣是週一掃 TISMIR、第一頁未讀的兩篇不合適之後，從第二頁依子領域挑的：它是音樂理解的問答基準，正好落在使用者在追的 benchmark。選它的理由是想檢查一個常見問題：一個號稱測「因果推理」的基準，用的卻是 143 類封閉式分類器，高分到底代表推理，還是只是答案分布的偏差。
entries.why_en: A dataset paper from the RITMO group at the University of Oslo that pushes music question answering beyond scene description such as which instrument sounds first, toward performer movement, audience interaction and causal why-questions. It also comes from Monday's TISMIR scan: after the two unread page-1 articles were set aside, I picked it from page 2 by subfield, since it is a music-understanding QA benchmark and falls in the benchmark subfield the user is tracking. I chose it to check a common problem: when a benchmark that claims to test causal reasoning uses a 143-class closed-set classifier, does a high score reflect reasoning or merely bias in the answer distribution?

motivation.zh:
作者指出既有音樂問答（MQA）有三個缺口。第一，很多系統只用音訊與文字，漏掉演奏動作、肢體溝通、舞台表現這些看得見的資訊。第二，有影像的資料集（MUSIC-AVQA 系列）偏重樂器辨識與位置，問的是「發生了什麼」而不是「為什麼」。第三，大量資料靠群眾外包或 LLM 生成，帶來含糊、不一致與偏差，曲風也集中在西方器樂。

所以 MusiQAl 的目標是三件事：用音樂學與音樂心理學的理論（具身音樂認知、音樂手勢研究）設計問題；收錄多元的表演傳統（爵士、拉格、非洲金貝鼓、玻里尼西亞舞蹈、佛朗明哥等），並納入歌唱與舞蹈，不只器樂；再用現有的影音問答模型測試，看這些新問題對它們有多難。
motivation.en:
The authors identify three gaps in existing music question answering (MQA). First, many systems use only audio and text, missing visible information such as playing gestures, bodily communication and stage presence. Second, datasets with video (the MUSIC-AVQA line) focus on instrument recognition and location, asking what is happening rather than why. Third, much data is crowdsourced or LLM-generated, which brings ambiguity, inconsistency and bias, and the styles are concentrated on Western instrumental music.

MusiQAl therefore aims at three things: designing questions from theories in musicology and music psychology (embodied music cognition, research on musical gestures); covering diverse performance traditions (jazz, raga, Malian djembe, Polynesian dance, flamenco and more) including singing and dance, not only instruments; and testing existing audio-visual QA models to see how hard these new questions are for them.

intro.zh:
最直接的前身是 MUSIC-AVQA（Li 等人，2022）：9,288 段 YouTube 影片、45,867 組群眾外包問答、33 個問題模板，也是本文基線 AVST 的出處；MUSIC-AVQA-v2.0（Liu 等人，2024）補了 1,230 段影片與 8,100 多組問答，專門修正原版問題分布的偏差。純音訊這邊有 MusicQA（112,878 個由 LLM 生成的開放式問題，搭配 MU-LLaMA）與 MuChoMusic（644 首曲子、1,187 題四選一，LLM 生成後人工驗證）。

MusiQAl 跟它們的差別在題目內容而非形式：它沿用 MUSIC-AVQA 的模板與答案格式，再加 47 個新模板（共 80 個）以及「因果」「目的」兩類問題，題目由作者設計、由音樂學碩士標註。換句話說，它在架構上最像一個規模約四分之一、但題材更廣的 MUSIC-AVQA。這也代表它繼承了 MUSIC-AVQA 系列最被詬病的問題——答案集合小、封閉式分類容易被答案先驗吃掉；而 v2.0 正是為這件事而做的，本文引用了它卻沒有做同樣的偏差檢查。
intro.en:
The most direct predecessor is MUSIC-AVQA (Li et al., 2022): 9,288 YouTube videos, 45,867 crowdsourced QA pairs and 33 question templates, and the source of the AVST baseline used here. MUSIC-AVQA-v2.0 (Liu et al., 2024) added 1,230 videos and over 8,100 QA pairs specifically to correct biased question distributions in the original. On the audio-only side there are MusicQA (112,878 LLM-generated open-ended questions, paired with MU-LLaMA) and MuChoMusic (644 tracks, 1,187 four-way multiple-choice questions, LLM-generated then human-validated).

MusiQAl differs from them in content rather than form: it reuses MUSIC-AVQA's templates and answer format, adds 47 new templates (80 in total) and two new categories, causal and purpose, with questions designed by the authors and annotated by musicology master's graduates. Structurally, it is closest to a MUSIC-AVQA about a quarter the size but with a wider range of material. That also means it inherits the most criticized weakness of the MUSIC-AVQA line, a small answer set where closed-set classification can be dominated by answer priors; v2.0 was built precisely for that issue, and this paper cites it without running the same bias check.

method.zh:
**資料。** 310 段影片、總長超過五小時，來源包括研究用錄影（IEMP 的馬利金貝鼓、MusicLab 哥本哈根的弦樂四重奏、HanonHands 的鋼琴練習曲）、希臘民謠資料集 GFMD、AudioSet，以及用無痕模式依關鍵字搜尋並人工篩選的 YouTube 影片。組成是 98 段純器樂、87 段歌唱、76 段舞蹈、49 段混合，涵蓋 47 種樂器（包括佛朗明哥踏步、筆電現場編碼、自動演奏吉他與機器人鐵琴）與 18 個國家。

**問題與標註。** 七類問題：存在、位置、計數、比較、時間，再加新的因果與目的；分成只看音訊、只看影像、影音並用三種情境。80 個模板帶有 `<Object>` 之類的佔位符。標註由音樂學碩士背景的研究助理在一個月內完成：兩位主要標註者各自選答案，兩人一致才算正確，不一致時由第三位裁決，其中一位有七年以上世界民族音樂經驗。原本得到 12,759 題的答案，為了讓答案分布平衡保留 11,793 題。

**基線實驗。** 沿用 AVST 的特徵管線：每段一分鐘影片取 80 幀，用 ResNet18 抽 512 維視覺特徵、R(2+1)D 抽 512 維動作特徵、VGGish 抽 128 維音訊特徵；問題最長 15 詞。訓練 AVST 與 LAVISH 兩個模型，所有題型共用一個模型，資料以分層抽樣切成 70/20/10。用 Optuna 跑 50 次試驗調超參數，AVST 得到學習率 1.46×10⁻⁴、batch 16，LAVISH 為 1.76×10⁻⁴、batch 1。輸出層改成 143 類，也就是說答案是從固定的 143 個候選裡選一個。結果報五次獨立執行的平均與標準差。
method.en:
**Data.** 310 videos totaling over five hours, drawn from research recordings (Malian djembe from IEMP, a string quartet from MusicLab Copenhagen, piano exercises from HanonHands), the Greek Folk Music Dataset (GFMD), AudioSet, and YouTube videos found through incognito keyword searches and manually screened. The split is 98 purely instrumental, 87 vocal, 76 dance and 49 mixed performances, covering 47 instruments (including flamenco footsteps, live-coding laptops, self-playing guitars and robot glockenspiels) and 18 countries.

**Questions and annotation.** Seven categories: existential, location, counting, comparative and temporal, plus the new causal and purpose; each posed in audio-only, video-only or audio-video settings. The 80 templates carry placeholders such as `<Object>`. Annotation was done over one month by research assistants with musicology master's degrees: two primary annotators chose answers independently, an answer counted as correct when both agreed, and a third resolved disagreements; one annotator had over seven years of experience in world folk music. Answers were obtained for 12,759 questions, of which 11,793 were kept to balance the answer distribution.

**Baselines.** The AVST feature pipeline is reused: 80 frames per one-minute video, 512-dimensional ResNet18 visual features, 512-dimensional R(2+1)D motion features and 128-dimensional VGGish audio features; questions are at most 15 words. AVST and LAVISH are trained with one model for all question types, on a stratified 70/20/10 split. Optuna ran 50 trials, giving AVST a learning rate of 1.46×10⁻⁴ with batch 16 and LAVISH 1.76×10⁻⁴ with batch 1. The output layer has 143 classes, so each answer is chosen from a fixed set of 143 candidates. Results are means and standard deviations over five independent runs.

limitation.zh:
**沒有偏差基線，「因果推理」的解讀站不住。** 答案是 143 類封閉分類，很多問題本質上是是非題（例如「場館聲學有沒有影響樂器擺放與聲音投射？」）。在這種設定下，最基本的對照是只給問題、不給影音的模型，或直接猜每個模板最常見的答案；文章兩者都沒做。沒有這條基線，影音因果題 LAVISH 76.99%、AVST 64.40% 這種數字無法說明模型「建立了因果關係」，作者在 5.2.2 節卻這樣解讀，討論節還說高分「證明資料集有效捕捉了表演的核心要素」。

**標註品質沒有數字。** 討論節說標註「經標註者一致性驗證」，但全文沒有報任何一致性指標（例如 Cohen's κ），也沒說第三位標註者裁決了多少比例。為了平衡答案分布刪掉的 966 題（12,759 − 11,793）怎麼挑的也沒交代。

**規模與評估範圍。** 310 段影片切 10% 當測試集，大約只有 31 段影片，分層抽樣也救不了某些曲風只出現幾次的問題；作者也承認沒做交叉驗證。相關研究提到 Gemini 1.5 Pro 與 VideoLLaMA 2 等影音 LLM，實驗卻只測兩個 2022–2023 年的分類模型。

**文字與表格有出入。** 只看影像的時間題，內文說 LAVISH 較好（69.63% vs 73.41%），但表 3 是 AVST 的 73.41% 較高。各模態的 Avg 也不是各類別的算術平均（例如 AVST 音訊五類平均是 74.98%，表上是 72.32%），推測是按題數加權，但沒說明。
limitation.en:
**There is no bias baseline, so the causal-reasoning reading does not hold up.** Answers come from a 143-class closed set, and many questions are essentially yes/no (e.g. does the venue's acoustics affect instrument placement and sound projection?). In such a setup the most basic control is a question-only model with no audio or video, or simply guessing the most frequent answer per template; the paper does neither. Without that baseline, numbers such as 76.99% for LAVISH and 64.40% for AVST on audio-video causal questions cannot show that the models establish cause–effect relationships, yet Section 5.2.2 reads them that way, and the discussion says the high scores demonstrate that the dataset effectively captures core elements of performance.

**Annotation quality has no numbers.** The discussion says annotations were validated by inter-annotator agreement, but no agreement statistic (e.g. Cohen's κ) is reported anywhere, nor the share of cases the third annotator resolved. How the 966 questions (12,759 − 11,793) dropped to balance the answer distribution were chosen is not explained.

**Scale and scope of evaluation.** A 10% test split of 310 videos is only about 31 videos, and stratified sampling cannot fix styles that appear only a few times; the authors also note no cross-validation was run. Related work mentions audio-visual LLMs such as Gemini 1.5 Pro and VideoLLaMA 2, but the experiments test only two classification models from 2022–2023.

**Text and table disagree.** For video-only temporal questions the text says LAVISH is better (69.63% vs 73.41%), but in Table 3 AVST's 73.41% is higher. The per-modality Avg values are also not arithmetic means of the categories (AVST's five audio categories average 74.98%, while the table shows 72.32%), presumably weighted by question count, which is not stated.

discussion.zh:
**結果本身。** 整體平均 LAVISH 69.78%、AVST 68.21%，只差 1.57 個百分點；影音並用時差距較大（70.08% vs 66.23%，+3.85）。兩個模型各有所長：音訊題 AVST 平均 72.32% 高於 LAVISH 的 66.03%，在存在題差最多（76.11% vs 55.00%）；影音題 LAVISH 在存在（80.80% vs 61.19%）、比較（82.37% vs 73.68%）、因果（76.99% vs 64.40%）較好。變異也不小，例如 LAVISH 音訊因果題的標準差是 ±8.94。作者觀察到的失敗模式比平均數更有資訊：曲風分類常被歸進「民謠」「流行」這種大類；多聲源重疊時的時間與計數題（「哪個樂器跟某物同時發聲」）準確率低於 55%；模型會把非歐洲傳統的服裝標成「制服」。

**它適合當什麼用。** 以 benchmark 角度看，MusiQAl 最有價值的是題目設計：把演奏手勢、舞台位置、觀眾互動與服裝、道具的意圖寫成可標註的問題，這在 MUSIC-AVQA 與 MuChoMusic 都沒有。資料、程式與標註指引都已公開（GitHub 與 Zenodo），這點比很多同類資料集好。

但在用它的分數宣稱模型會「推理」之前，至少要補三件事：只看問題的偏差基線、每個模板的多數答案基線，以及標註一致性。作者規劃的多標籤標註（一題允許多個正確答案）是對的方向，因為很多因果與目的題本來就沒有唯一解。把它改成開放式生成並用影音 LLM 測，可能比在 143 類分類器上調參更能看出這些題目真正的難度。
discussion.en:
**The results themselves.** Overall, LAVISH averages 69.78% and AVST 68.21%, a gap of only 1.57 points; with audio and video combined the gap is larger (70.08% vs 66.23%, +3.85). Each model has strengths: on audio questions AVST averages 72.32% against LAVISH's 66.03%, with the largest gap on existential questions (76.11% vs 55.00%); on audio-video questions LAVISH is better on existential (80.80% vs 61.19%), comparative (82.37% vs 73.68%) and causal (76.99% vs 64.40%). Variance is not small, e.g. ±8.94 for LAVISH on audio causal questions. The failure modes the authors observe are more informative than the averages: styles are often lumped into broad classes such as folk or pop; temporal and counting questions with overlapping sources (which instrument sounds at the same time as an object) fall below 55%; and the models label clothing from non-European traditions as a uniform.

**What it is good for.** As a benchmark, MusiQAl's main value is its question design: it turns playing gestures, stage position, audience interaction and the intent behind attire and props into annotatable questions, which neither MUSIC-AVQA nor MuChoMusic has. Data, code and annotation guidelines are released (GitHub and Zenodo), better than many similar datasets.

But before its scores are used to claim that a model reasons, at least three things are needed: a question-only bias baseline, a per-template majority-answer baseline, and annotation agreement. The planned multi-label annotation (several correct answers per question) is the right direction, since many causal and purpose questions have no unique answer. Recasting it as open-ended generation and testing audio-visual LLMs may reveal the real difficulty of these questions better than tuning a 143-class classifier.

entries.title_en: Data-Driven Analysis of Text-Conditioning in AI-Generated Music: A Case Study with Suno and Udio
entries.title_zh: Suno 與 Udio 的文字條件資料分析：從兩個平台「新歌」公開歌單爬下 2024 年 5–10 月 60,342 位使用者的 101,953 首歌，用 NV-Embed-v2＋UMAP＋HDBSCAN 對提示、歌詞與標籤分群——Suno 歌詞只有 46.75% 是英文、英文歌詞 42,163 首有 25,794 首被歸為離群、最大單一群是 854 首宗教歌曲、Udio 把 703 位真實藝人名替換成通用標籤；方法本質上是 BERTopic 式流程，分群參數靠試誤，語言表有標錯代碼
entries.authors: Luca Casini, Laura Cros Vila, David Dalmazzo, Anna-Kaisa Kaila, Bob L.T. Sturm
entries.why_zh: KTH 的 Sturm 團隊（ERC MUSAiC 計畫）第一次大規模分析商用文字生成音樂平台的使用者實際怎麼下提示、寫什麼歌詞、用哪些標籤與方括號「元標籤」。同樣來自週一的 TISMIR 掃描第二頁。選它有兩個原因：生成式音樂研究幾乎都在評估模型，很少看使用者；而且它的倫理聲明直接以歐盟 DSM 指令（2019/790）為爬取違反服務條款的資料辯護，正好可以跟昨天讀的 Stober 與 Dornis 著作權綜述對照——那篇爭論的是「訓練」是否屬於文字與資料探勘，這篇做的則是典型的分析型探勘。
entries.why_en: The first large-scale analysis, from Sturm's group at KTH (ERC project MUSAiC), of how users of commercial text-to-music platforms actually write prompts, what lyrics they write, and which tags and square-bracket metatags they use. It also comes from page 2 of Monday's TISMIR scan. I chose it for two reasons: generative-music research almost always evaluates models and rarely looks at users; and its ethics statement defends scraping that breaches the platforms' terms of service by citing the EU DSM Directive (2019/790), which pairs well with yesterday's Stober and Dornis copyright overview, which argued over whether training counts as text and data mining, whereas this paper does textbook analytical mining.

motivation.zh:
文字已經是生成式 AI 的主要介面，而 Suno 宣稱使用者每天生成約七百萬段錄音，AI 音樂也開始出現在歐洲排行榜、廣告與健身房歌單。作者引用的 2024 年調查顯示，GEMA 與 SACEM 會員有 35% 在工作中使用 AI，35 歲以下達 51%。但到目前為止，沒有人系統性地看過這些平台實際上是怎麼被使用的。

作者想用資料科學的方法，把音樂學的提問從「細讀單一作品」轉成「觀察整個社群的大規模模式」，並列出六個研究問題：輸入文字用哪些語言、提示有什麼特徵、歌詞有什麼特徵、標籤有什麼特徵、使用者怎麼提到真實藝人、歌詞裡塞了哪些額外指令（元標籤）。貢獻有三：一套分析文字條件的方法、公開的程式與歌曲網址清單，以及可互動瀏覽的視覺化。
motivation.en:
Text is now the main interface to generative AI, Suno says its users generate about seven million recordings a day, and AI music is appearing on European charts, in advertising and in gym playlists. A 2024 survey the authors cite finds that 35% of GEMA and SACEM members use AI in their work, rising to 51% among those under 35. Yet nobody has systematically examined how these platforms are actually used.

The authors want to use data-science methods to shift the musicological question from close reading of single works to large-scale patterns across a community, and pose six research questions: which languages appear in the text inputs, what characterizes prompts, lyrics and tags, how users mention real artists, and what extra instructions (metatags) appear in lyrics. The contributions are a method for analyzing text conditioning, released code with a list of song URLs, and interactive visualizations.

intro.zh:
作者的方法直接借自文生圖的使用者研究：Sanchez（2023）分析 DiffusionDB——Stable Diffusion 真實使用者的 1,400 萬組圖與提示——建立提示修飾詞的分類法並訓練分類器；McCormack 等人（2024）再加入 Midjourney 資料做分群與主題模型，兩者都用 UMAP＋HDBSCAN。音樂這邊唯一接近的是 SONICS（Rahman 等人，2024），約 49,000 首用模板生成的 Suno／Udio 歌曲，是拿來訓練 AI 音樂偵測器的，不代表真實用法。歌詞分析則接上 MIR 的情緒、曲風分類傳統，以及 Varnum 等人（2021）、Parada-Cabaleiro 等人（2024）那種用歌詞研究流行音樂長期變化的文化分析。

文章自稱「發展了一套新方法」，但它最像的其實是 BERTopic（Grootendorst，2022）：先用句向量嵌入、UMAP 降維、HDBSCAN 分群，再用 class-based TF-IDF 取每群的關鍵詞命名——跟本文的流程幾乎一步不差，文中卻沒有提到。所以新的不是方法，而是把它用在一個以前沒人收集過的資料上；真正有原創性的部分是第 6.5 與 6.6 節那些平台特有的現象（藝人名替換、元標籤）。
intro.en:
The method is borrowed directly from user studies of text-to-image generation. Sanchez (2023) analyzed DiffusionDB, 14 million images and prompts from real Stable Diffusion users, built a taxonomy of prompt specifiers and trained a classifier; McCormack et al. (2024) added Midjourney data with clustering and topic modeling, both using UMAP with HDBSCAN. On the music side the only close work is SONICS (Rahman et al., 2024), about 49,000 template-generated Suno/Udio songs meant for training AI-music detectors, which does not reflect real use. Lyrics analysis connects to the MIR tradition of mood and genre classification and to cultural analyses of long-term change in popular music through lyrics, such as Varnum et al. (2021) and Parada-Cabaleiro et al. (2024).

The paper says it develops a new methodology, but what it most resembles is BERTopic (Grootendorst, 2022): sentence embeddings, UMAP reduction, HDBSCAN clustering, then class-based TF-IDF keywords to name each cluster, which matches this pipeline almost step for step and is not mentioned. So the novelty is not the method but its application to data nobody had collected before; the genuinely original parts are the platform-specific phenomena in Sections 6.5 and 6.6 (artist-name replacement and metatags).

method.zh:
**資料收集。** 從兩個平台首頁定期更新的「新歌」歌單抓取 HTTP 請求中的詮釋資料，2024 年 5 月到 10 月共 101,953 首（Suno 81,434、Udio 20,519），來自 60,342 位使用者。作者假設這些歌單是最少人工挑選、最接近隨機抽樣的來源，但也承認不知道歌單怎麼產生。兩個平台的欄位意義不一致（Suno 的 prompt 其實是歌詞），所以作者重新定義了「歌詞」「標籤」「提示」三個詞。

**分析流程。** 用 fastText 做語言辨識，英文以外的提示與歌詞在分群時排除；用 NV-Embed-v2 產生 4,096 維嵌入，UMAP 降到五維後跑 HDBSCAN，再用 TF-IDF 前三名關鍵詞（標籤則用詞頻）自動命名群，人工檢查並改名，最後投影到二維畫圖。超參數靠反覆試誤。提示部分：41,108 筆有提示，去掉過長、非英文與重複後剩 16,881 筆，得到 81 群。歌詞部分：先刪掉方括號裡的結構標記，去掉器樂曲與過長者後有 42,163 首英文歌詞，得到 190 群加上 25,794 首離群，再人工歸成 26 個大類。

**標籤與元標籤。** 先從 Udio 逗號分隔的標籤建出 7,656 個詞的詞彙表，再拿去切 Suno 的自由文字標籤；共有 24,058 個不重複標籤，其中 76.02% 只出現一次，只分析出現至少 10 次的 1,245 個。因為直接分群會讓「吉他、搖滾、激烈」黏在一起，作者先手動建一個高層分類（曲風、修飾詞、樂器、結構、人聲、年代、調性、BPM），用它引導 UMAP，最後得到 85 群，並對每首歌各類標籤的數量擬合卜瓦松分布。元標籤只抓方括號，數字（如 Chorus 2）合併計算。
method.en:
**Collection.** Metadata were taken from the HTTP requests behind each platform's regularly updated new-songs playlist: 101,953 songs from May to October 2024 (81,434 Suno, 20,519 Udio) by 60,342 users. The authors assume these playlists are minimally curated and the closest proxy to random sampling, while admitting they do not know how the playlists are populated. Field meanings differ between platforms (Suno's prompt is actually the lyrics), so the authors redefine lyrics, tags and prompt.

**Pipeline.** fastText language identification is used to exclude non-English prompts and lyrics from clustering; NV-Embed-v2 produces 4,096-dimensional embeddings, UMAP reduces them to five dimensions, HDBSCAN clusters them, and clusters are named automatically by their top three TF-IDF keywords (term counts for tags), then inspected and renamed by hand and projected to 2D for plotting. Hyperparameters were set by trial and error. Prompts: 41,108 songs have one; after removing overly long, non-English and duplicate prompts, 16,881 remain, giving 81 clusters. Lyrics: after stripping bracketed structure markers and removing instrumentals and overly long lyrics, 42,163 English lyrics remain, giving 190 clusters plus 25,794 outliers, grouped by hand into 26 macro-categories.

**Tags and metatags.** A 7,656-term vocabulary is built from Udio's comma-separated tags and used to segment Suno's free-text tags; there are 24,058 unique tags, 76.02% appearing once, and only the 1,245 appearing at least 10 times are analyzed. Because direct clustering pulls guitar, rock and aggressive together, the authors first hand-build a high-level taxonomy (genre, qualifier, instrument, structure, voice, year, key, BPM) to guide UMAP, ending with 85 clusters, and fit a Poisson distribution to the per-song count of tags in each category. Metatags are captured only within square brackets, with numbers (e.g. Chorus 2) merged.

limitation.zh:
**分群結果沒有驗證。** UMAP 與 HDBSCAN 的參數「靠試誤，找出能給出有意義群數的組合」，沒有任何群集品質指標、沒有不同參數或隨機種子下的穩定度、也沒有人工標註的子集來檢查群名對不對。英文歌詞 42,163 首中有 25,794 首（61%）被歸為離群，作者說這不是問題，但這意味著表 3 的主題分布只描述了 39% 的歌詞；作者自己也發現許多離群其實可以併入既有群。

**樣本的代表性。** 只看使用者選擇公開的歌，作者承認這是無法繞過的偏差；分群又只用英文，而 Suno 歌詞只有 46.75% 是英文。這導致一些看得見的扭曲：作者自己指出以色列相關的歌大多用希伯來文寫，被語言過濾掉，所以圖上只看得到巴勒斯坦的群。

**表格錯誤。** 表 2 的語言代碼有兩處標錯：`yue_Hant` 是粵語（繁體字），卻標成「Chinese」；`ind_Latn` 是印尼語，卻標成「Indian」（Suno 3.26%）。表 5 的標題寫「前 10 名」，內文卻說「前 20 名」。表 4 中 UNDEFINED 的 Suno λ 為 −1.26，卜瓦松分布的期望值不可能是負的；表頭寫 P(X>1)，內文卻說是「至少一個」的機率。這些都不影響主要結論，但會讓人對其他數字少一點信心。

**資料與法律。** 作者明說爬取違反兩個平台的服務條款，並以 DSM 指令為依據認為合法；為此只公開網址清單，不公開詮釋資料與爬蟲。投稿時 Udio 有 4.59%、Suno 有 1.02% 的網址已失效，可重現性會隨時間繼續下降。
limitation.en:
**The clustering is not validated.** UMAP and HDBSCAN parameters were chosen by trial and error to give a meaningful number of clusters, with no cluster-quality metric, no stability check across parameters or random seeds, and no human-labeled subset to verify cluster names. Of 42,163 English lyrics, 25,794 (61%) are outliers; the authors say this is not a problem, but it means the theme distribution in Table 3 describes only 39% of the lyrics, and the authors themselves find that many outliers could be merged into existing clusters.

**Representativeness.** Only songs users chose to publish are seen, which the authors admit cannot be avoided; clustering uses only English, while only 46.75% of Suno lyrics are English. This creates visible distortions: the authors note that Israel-related songs are mostly in Hebrew and filtered out by language detection, so only a Palestine cluster appears in the plot.

**Table errors.** Table 2 mislabels two language codes: `yue_Hant` is Cantonese (traditional script) but labeled Chinese, and `ind_Latn` is Indonesian but labeled Indian (3.26% on Suno). Table 5's caption says top 10 while the text says top 20. In Table 4, UNDEFINED has a Suno λ of −1.26, but a Poisson mean cannot be negative, and the header says P(X>1) while the text calls it the probability of at least one. None of this changes the main conclusions, but it lowers confidence in the other numbers.

**Data and law.** The authors state that scraping breaches both platforms' terms of service and argue it is lawful under the DSM Directive; accordingly they release only the URL list, not the metadata or the scraper. At submission 4.59% of Udio and 1.02% of Suno URLs were already unreachable, so reproducibility will keep declining.

discussion.zh:
**看到了什麼。** 歌詞的最大宗是愛情（26 個大類中的 2,182 首），但最大的單一群是 854 首宗教歌曲（「love」「god」「lord」最常見，以基督教與伊斯蘭教為主）。其他明顯的用途包括替特定的人與節日量身做歌（生日、聖誕）、寵物與食物（cats 280 首、cheese 522 首）、迷因、2024 年美國大選與以巴衝突，以及數量相近的擁護 AI 與反對 AI 的歌。提示有兩種極端寫法：逗號分隔的修飾詞清單，與描述內容或聲音的文學式句子；還有一群明顯是外部服務程式化產生的提示，連沒替換的 `{moodsGenre}` 佔位符都留著。標籤方面，Udio 每首歌平均的曲風標籤期望值是 3.90，Suno 只有 1.15。

**最有意思的是平台機制。** Udio 會把真實藝人名替換成通用描述，作者在 20,519 首中找到 1,000 次替換、703 位不同藝人，最多的是 XXXTentacion（26 次）、Drake（19 次）、Taylor Swift 與 Foo Fighters（各 18 次）；同一位藝人的替換標籤不總是一樣，暗示背後是動態系統而非查表。Suno 則直接禁止在標籤裡用藝人名，結果使用者把名字塞進歌詞的方括號元標籤裡（例如「produced by bob marley and lee perry」）。元標籤以結構為主：verse 88,270 次、chorus 65,342 次、bridge 22,491 次。這些是一般模型評估看不到的、使用者與平台之間的拉鋸。

**對 MIR 的意義。** 這篇的價值在於把「生成式音樂」的研究對象從模型移到使用者，並示範了一個可以延伸到音訊特徵的起點。但它目前比較像一張探索地圖而非量測：群的大小與名稱都經過大量人工判斷，沒有驗證就不適合拿來做跨平台或跨時間的比較。若要成為後續研究的基準，下一步應該是用人工標註的子集驗證分群，並把非英文的一半資料納入。
discussion.en:
**What it finds.** Love is the largest lyric theme (2,182 songs among the 26 macro-categories), but the largest single cluster is 854 worship songs (love, god and lord most frequent, mainly Christianity and Islam). Other clear uses include bespoke songs for particular people and holidays (birthdays, Christmas), pets and food (280 cats, 522 cheese), memes, the 2024 US election and the Israeli–Palestinian conflict, and roughly equal numbers of songs praising and opposing AI. Prompts follow two extremes: comma-separated lists of qualifiers, and literary sentences describing content or sound; a group of prompts is clearly generated by an external service, down to an unreplaced `{moodsGenre}` placeholder. For tags, the expected number of genre tags per song is 3.90 on Udio but only 1.15 on Suno.

**The most interesting part is platform mechanics.** Udio replaces real artist names with generic descriptors; in 20,519 songs the authors find 1,000 replacements of 703 distinct artists, led by XXXTentacion (26), Drake (19), and Taylor Swift and Foo Fighters (18 each). The replacement tags for the same artist are not always identical, suggesting a dynamic system rather than a lookup table. Suno instead forbids artist names in tags, so users put names in bracketed metatags in the lyrics (e.g. produced by bob marley and lee perry). Metatags are mostly structural: verse 88,270 times, chorus 65,342 and bridge 22,491. This is the tug-of-war between users and platforms that ordinary model evaluation never sees.

**What it means for MIR.** The paper's value is in moving the object of generative-music research from models to users, and in offering a starting point that can be extended to audio features. For now, though, it is more an exploratory map than a measurement: cluster sizes and names involve heavy manual judgment, and without validation they are not suitable for cross-platform or cross-time comparison. To become a basis for later work, the next steps are validating the clusters on a human-labeled subset and bringing in the non-English half of the data.
